HDFS-16967.title: RBF: File based state stores should allow concurrent access to the records
HDFS-16967.description:
File based state store implementations (StateStoreFileImpl and StateStoreFileSystemImpl) should allow updating as well as reading of the state store records concurrently rather than serially. Concurrent access to the record files on the hdfs based store seems to be improving the state store cache loading performance by more than 10x.

For instance, in order to maintain data integrity, when any mount table record(s) is updated, the cache is reloaded. This reload operation seems to be able to gain significant performance improvement by the concurrent access of the mount table records.

commits.message: HDFS-16967. RBF: File based state stores should allow concurrent access to the records
commits.author: virajjasani

HDFS-16971.title: Add read time metrics for remote reads in Statistics
HDFS-16971.description:
In Filesystem.java, currently it only collects bytes read not the corresponding timing of reads.
In particular, we're interested in time spent on remote reads(not local reads). Adding timing info will help us understand it better and further analyze how locality of DN behaves.

commits.message: add read metrics for remote reads in FileSystem Statistics
commits.author: Melissa You

HDFS-16974.title: Consider volumes average load of each DataNode when choosing target.
HDFS-16974.description: The current target choosing policy only considers the load of the entire datanode. If both DN1 and DN2 have an `xceiverCount` of 100, but DN1 has 10 volumes to write to and DN2 only has 1, then the pressure on DN2 is actually much greater than that on DN1. This patch has added a configuration that allows us to avoid nodes with too much pressure on a single volume when choosing targets, so as to avoid overloading datanodes with few volumes or slowing down writes.

commits.message: HDFS-16974. Consider load of every volume when choosing target.
commits.author: zhangshuyan0

HDFS-17009.title: RBF: state store putAll should also return failed records
HDFS-17009.description: State store implementations allow adding/updating multiple records using putAll. The implementation returns whether all records were successfully added or updated. We should also allow the implementation to return which records failed to get updated.

commits.message: HDFS-17009. RBF: state store putAll should also return failed records
commits.author: virajjasani

HDFS-17037.title: Consider nonDfsUsed when running balancer
HDFS-17037.description: When we run balancer with `BalancingPolicy.Node` policy, our goal is to make each datanode storage balanced. But in the current implementation, the balancer doesn't account for storage used by non-dfs on the datanodes, which can make the situation worse for datanodes that are already strained on storage.

commits.message: HDFS-17037. Consider nonDfsUsed when running balancer.
commits.author: zhangshuyan0
